Recorded claim:
`BrowserTestUtils.waitForAttribute(attr, element, value)` resolves only on a future mutation. If `openAndShowEvent()` has already opened the dialog and it already has `status="NEEDS-ACTION"`, assert `getAttribute()` directly; use the helper only for a later expected mutation. The timeout occurred on Windows, Linux, and macOS. [Task 1]
